text:
Ryan O'Reilly scored both Nashville goals in regulation Friday in Vegas, the second tying it with 10:16 left, before Roman Josi won it in the shootout for a seventh straight win. Vegas Hockey Knight's headline said it best: "Ryan O'Reilly haunts Vegas (again)." The 2019 Conn Smythe winner, now 35, has 9 goals and 19 points in 20 games, nine on the power play.

The finishing is the hot part. Nine goals on 5.99 expected goals (the quality of his chances) means he's shooting 25.7%, far above our talent range for him (13.1% to 18%) and the 16% he shot last season. Before Friday the bigger worry was volume: he had no shots in four of his previous eight games. What hasn't changed is the setup game. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 9.9 primary shot assists per 60 last season, 93rd percentile among forwards, and NHL EDGE puts his top speed in the 93rd percentile. His goals have mattered, too: by our wins added, which credits each goal by how much it moved the odds of winning, he ranks 21st of 528 skaters.
headline: Ryan O'Reilly haunts Vegas again
